name: Comunicate.top API
description: Publish advertorials and press releases on 3.800+ websites in Romania, Italy and beyond. The catalogue, niches and market statistics are free to read without a key; publishing needs an API key or an OAuth 2.1 token. Also available as an MCP server for AI assistants.

apis.name: Comunicate.top Public Catalogue API
apis.description: Free and read-only, no key and no sign-up: the niches of a 3.800-publication network, the catalogue figures, and market statistics — authority distribution, turnaround times and the going price per campaign type. There is deliberately no route that returns the whole publication list.

apis.name: Comunicate.top Partner API
apis.description: The full API: catalogue with prices, article drafts and uploads, orders, publications with their live URLs, campaigns, balance, reports and webhooks. Authenticates with an API key or OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
